source: Direct customer question received by SiteSutra

query_evidence.query: How will I get external authority?
query_evidence.interpretation: Evidence of a buyer question about earning third-party references; it is not verified search demand, volume or difficulty.

editorial_decision.buyer_question: How can a small-business website earn trustworthy links?
editorial_decision.distinct_task: Assess legitimate link opportunities, create a reference-worthy destination and avoid paid or automated link schemes.

limitations: The wording confirms that one prospective buyer asked the question; it does not establish wider demand or commercial value.
The article supports a link-opportunity decision and does not replace the canonical technical SEO service page.
Search visibility, AI citations and qualified enquiries remain separate measures.
